newsitem.title: INDIA: India Ispat allowed to issue debentures.
newsitem.headline: India Ispat allowed to issue debentures.

text.p: The Indian government said on Thursday that it approved a proposal by Nippon Denro Ispat Ltd to issue 875,000, 15-percent fully convertible debentures on a private placement basis to foreign investors.

It said in a statement that the Cabinet Committee on Foreign Investment approved the proposal to issue the debentures, which when converted would equal 1.84 billion rupees' worth of equity held by foreign entities.
A company spokesman said Nippon Denro Ispat, which is setting up a three-million-tonne hot strip steel mill, recently changed its name to Ispat Industries Ltd.
The government statement said the debentures would be valued at 100 rupees each.

"The foreign equity on conversion of these FCDs (fully convertible debentures) within 18 months from the date of issue will be equivalent to 28.90 percent amounting to 1.8442 billion rupees," it said.
